The '''Genetech Orbiting Research Lab''', also known as the '''Genetech Laboratories Orbital Research Station''', was a small [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gorsh]]. It was owned by [[Genetech Laboratories]] and housed forty personnel of the company, including thirty research [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]].

Teams of the researchers regularly visited the surface of Gorsh in the station's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]]. The scientists used the natural compounds obtained on the planet to develop useful pharmaceuticals and medicines aboard the Genetech Orbiting Research Lab. The station's personnel also used automated, remote-controlled research probes to investigate Gorsh.

==Description==
The Genetech Orbiting Research Lab,<ref name="Planets" /> also known as the Genetech Laboratories Orbital Research Station<ref name="PoG1" /> or simply the Genetech Research Lab, was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] occupying a geosynchronous [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gorsh]]. The latter was a [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] with [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]]-covered [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] islands and was the only habitable world in the [[Gorsh system/Legends|Gorsh system]]<ref name="Planets" /> of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="TEA" />

The small orbital facility, which had a cargo capacity of three hundred [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]], was fifty-three [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and measured twenty-two meters in diameter. It consisted of two cylindrical sections, the smaller of which housed the living quarters of the station's occupants and the larger of which contained the facility's four [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]]. The two cylinders were joined by a pair of mutually inverted conical sections.<ref name="Planets" />

Another cone, located at the bottom of the larger cylinder of the lightly armed station, housed dual fire-linked [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] on its exterior.<ref name="Planets" /> The conical section gave way to a single large [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]]<ref name="PoG1" /> with four large [[Solar collector/Legends|solar collectors]] placed at its very bottom. A [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]] was situated atop the smaller of the two cylindrical sections. In addition, the cylinder housing the power cells was emblazoned with the logo of [[Genetech Laboratories]], the owner of the space station.<ref name="Planets" />

==History==
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Genetech Laboratories financed the first extensive [[Scout/Legends|explorations]] of the Gorsh [[Star system/Legends|system]], and the Empire granted the company ownership of everything within the system. Subsequently, the Genetech Orbiting Research Lab, which was not for sale and served as the only lifeline between the system and the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], was established in an orbit around the planet Gorsh.<ref name="Planets" />

Teams consisting of one dozen Genetech research [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] and a few armed [[Security guard/Legends|guards]] regularly traveled from the station to the surface of Gorsh. There, the scientists gathered unique natural compounds that were later used aboard the orbital [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] to develop successful pharmaceutical and medicinal products for the company. The Genetech Orbiting Research Labs also dispatched to Gorsh remote probes that could be controlled directly from the station, with followup teams being sent to the planet's surface to investigate if the probes discovered anything unusual.<ref name="Planets" />

==Inhabitants==
[[File:Gorsh_world_map.jpg|thumb|left|265px|The Genetech Orbiting Research Lab orbited the planet Gorsh.]]
The crew of the Genetech Orbiting Research Lab, which was owned by Genetech Laboratories, numbered five, including one [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]]. The station also housed forty passengers, of which thirty were research scientists and ten were Genetech guards. The facility had the bare minimum of necessary supplies, although it did have enough consumables aboard to supports its personnel for six [[Standard month/Legends|months]]. The researcher teams that traveled from the station to the surface of Gorsh were equipped with survival gear, medicines, [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]], [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]], specimen containers, [[chemical analyzer]]s, [[pocket computer]]s, [[biochem synthesizer]]s, and additional necessary field gear.<ref name="Planets" />

==Locations==
The top section of the cramped, spartan Genetech Orbiting Research Lab contained the living quarters of the station's personnel and included staff quarters, a kitchen, and a lounge. Further down, the conical section attached to the largest cylindrical portion of the facility contained<ref name="Planets" /> fifteen research labs and specimen facilities.<ref name="PoG1" />

That same cylinder also housed a launch tube for the station's<ref name="Planets" /> twelve automated research probes<ref name="PoG1" /> that could be controlled directly from the station.<ref name="Planets" /> The docking bay of the Genetech Orbiting Research Lab, which serviced the facility's complement of four three-person [[Dropship/Legends|drop-shuttles]] and one ten-person research [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], was equipped with a [[Docking tube/Legends|docking hood]].<ref name="PoG1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Genetech Orbiting Research Lab was introduced in ''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]'', a [[1991]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. [[John Paul Lona]] provided an illustration of the station for the book.<ref name="PoG1" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Gorsh system, and therefore the Genetech Orbiting Research Lab, in grid square O-3.<ref name="TEA" />
